editorial:
Imagine being the city's biggest hero one day and then watching everything fall apart the next. That is exactly what happens to Wu Ying-xiong, a brave cop who saved a plane full of people but now has to face a series of scary bombs hitting the city. You get to follow him and his new partner, who is basically his total opposite. Their chemistry is great because they clash over everything, but they are the only ones who can stop a massive conspiracy from destroying Harbor City. The vibe is very high-stakes and feels like a race against time, making you feel the pressure as the clock ticks down.

You will love the action scenes and the way the plot twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the story get a bit complicated, the acting keeps you grounded in the emotion of the situation. If you enjoy police thrillers with a lot of heart, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist where you find out the real villains are actually high-up government officials. They staged the attacks to keep power and control the public. Wu Ying-xiong and his partner manage to expose the truth and stop the final bombing. Even though they win, the ending shows that justice is messy and not always black and white, leaving you thinking about who the real bad guys are in society.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves police thrillers and conspiracy stories.
